Team Rocket’s Ambition Superfan Hackathon
Fellow Team Rocket superfans - this our moment! Join us live as we commence the Pokémon TCG Pocket hackathon in an ambitious attempt to take control of the Pokémon TCG Pocket app.

Your efforts so far have been invaluable, now it is time for the final push. Help us crack the codes and solve the puzzles so we can complete the master plan. All on behalf of our favourite organisation, Team Rocket!
Team Rocket’s Ambition is the latest expansion coming to Pokémon TCG Pocket, launching in-app on August 27th.
